summary: ServeSync iteration 4 tested. BACKEND — 17/17 iteration-4 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py (+ prior 22/22 iteration-3 still green): PATCH /api/orders/{id}/status accepts status='cancelled' from both 'pending' and 'preparing', persists to Mongo, cancelled order still fetchable via GET /api/orders/{id} and appears in GET /api/orders?status=cancelled; status='foobar' → 422; unknown order → 404; pending→preparing→completed lifecycle regression still works; auth (admin/master/chef passwords), categories, menu, orders listing, order-id format (YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-XXXXXXXX 8-hex) and unpaid default all still work. FRONTEND STRUCTURE (all testIDs correct + UI renders): (a) Chef tab bar has Dashboard | Pending | Preparing | Completed with Dashboard as default landing tab (testID chef-tab-dashboard). (b) Chef Dashboard shows 'Kitchen Board' title, '{preparing} preparing · {pending} pending' subtitle, legend pills for Preparing (brand tertiary) and Pending (warning), 'Total items: N' counter, and either the empty state 'Board is empty' or the horizontally-scrollable matrix (testID dashboard-matrix). Matrix column headers display short id '#XXXXXXXX' + T-{table} sub-line, last column is brand-background 'Total', row totals equal sum-of-qty across visible orders (verified: Paneer Tikka row totals = 2+1 = 3 across two visible order columns). (c) Master Orders filter chips all 5 present: orders-filter-all/pending/preparing/completed/cancelled. Cancel link testIDs render only on pending & preparing cards (0 links on completed filter, confirmed). Completed and cancelled cards do NOT render the cancel link. CRITICAL WEB-PREVIEW ISSUE: `Alert.alert(title, msg, buttons)` is a no-op on react-native-web 0.21 (the library used here). Clicking the Cancel link on either the Master orders card (`cancel-order-link-{id}`) or the Chef ticket card (`cancel-ticket-link-{id}`) does NOT open any confirm dialog and does NOT call PATCH /api/orders/{id}/status — verified by pointerdown+mousedown+click event dispatch AND with playwright's dialog handler (0 dialogs captured, /api/orders?status=cancelled count unchanged). On native iOS/Android Alert.alert works, so this is a WEB-ONLY functional break of iteration-4 cancel feature. Deprecated packages: none. Carry-over RN Web warnings: 'shadow*' style props (theme.ts) and 'props.pointerEvents' (master/index.tsx) still logged (non-blocking).

integration_issues.flow: Cancel order/ticket confirmation (both Master orders & Chef tickets)
integration_issues.issue: Alert.alert(title, msg, [Keep, Cancel Order]) is a NO-OP on react-native-web 0.21. Confirming 'Cancel' never fires the destructive onPress → PATCH /api/orders/{id}/status is never called → order stays pending on web preview. Verified: 0 dialogs opened, backend /api/orders?status=cancelled count unchanged after clicking cancel link. Works fine on native iOS/Android. Fix: replace Alert.alert with a cross-platform confirm — e.g. Platform.OS === 'web' ? (window.confirm(msg) && onConfirm()) : Alert.alert(...) — or use a custom Modal component. Affected files: /app/frontend/src/components/TicketList.tsx:95-108 (cancelTicket), /app/frontend/app/master/orders.tsx:78-103 (cancelOrder).

react_native_issues.issue: Alert.alert with button callbacks is a no-op on react-native-web 0.21. Use a Platform-branched confirm (window.confirm on web, Alert.alert on native) or a custom Modal. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/TicketList.tsx:95, /app/frontend/app/master/orders.tsx:78
(carry-over from iter 2/3) uses `pointerEvents="box-none"` prop — deprecated on RN Web. Reference: /app/frontend/app/master/index.tsx:364. Move to style.pointerEvents.
(carry-over) 'shadow*' style props deprecated on RN Web — migrate to boxShadow. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts

action_items: [HIGH] Replace `Alert.alert` cancel-confirmation in /app/frontend/src/components/TicketList.tsx (cancelTicket) and /app/frontend/app/master/orders.tsx (cancelOrder) with a cross-platform confirm. Simple fix: `import { Platform } from 'react-native';` then `const ok = Platform.OS === 'web' ? window.confirm('Cancel order?') : await new Promise(res => Alert.alert('Cancel order?','...',[{text:'Keep',onPress:()=>res(false),style:'cancel'},{text:'Cancel Order',onPress:()=>res(true),style:'destructive'}]));`. Iteration-4 cancel feature is UNUSABLE on web preview until this is fixed. Native iOS/Android works today.
[NIT carry-over] Migrate `pointerEvents` prop → style.pointerEvents in /app/frontend/app/master/index.tsx line 364.
[NIT carry-over] Migrate `shadow.*` styles → `boxShadow` in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts for RN Web parity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py Order model: status Literal now includes 'cancelled' (line 95) and OrderStatusUpdate mirrors it (line 111). Correct — Pydantic will 422 on any other value.

chef/index.tsx buildMatrix(): correctly aggregates qty per (item, order), computes row totals and grandTotal. Preparing orders sorted before pending (both oldest-first inside each) — matches spec 'preparing first then pending'.

master/orders.tsx cancelOrder: does an optimistic UI update (setOrders → status='cancelled') BEFORE api.updateStatus completes. If API fails it restores via load() — good UX pattern, but on error it also shows Alert.alert('Failed to cancel') which itself is a no-op on web, so the user sees the reverted card with no error toast on web. Consider adding an inline error banner instead.

TicketList.tsx cancelTicket: does NOT do an optimistic remove (relies solely on Alert.alert callback → api.updateStatus → next load()). Given Alert.alert is a no-op on web, the click is a complete no-op — no visual feedback whatsoever. Even after fix, consider optimistic UI here too.

master/orders.tsx: FILTERS array includes 'cancelled' chip → uses same statusStyle switch which returns {bg:'#FFE5E3', fg:colors.error} — the red CANCELLED pill spec is met.

rca_of_issue: RCA — Cancel link no-op on web preview: react-native-web 0.21 does not implement Alert.alert with button callbacks (it silently drops the call). Both cancelTicket (TicketList.tsx:95) and cancelOrder (master/orders.tsx:78) rely on Alert.alert's onPress destructive callback to fire PATCH /api/orders/{id}/status; that callback is never invoked on web. Reproduction: (1) login chef Sari0808 → Pending tab → click 'Cancel' on any ticket → observe (a) no dialog opens, (b) ticket remains, (c) GET /api/orders?status=cancelled count unchanged. Mitigation: use Platform-branched confirm or replace Alert.alert with a custom cross-platform Modal component (see action item #1).
